title: T1 Failing scenario: a computer-owner turn is counted twice on the vendor ledger
description: Plan: docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md finding F1. Files: features/cost_call_records.feature (new, add to features/cucumber-features.txt), steps in conversation/features-support/steps/ (reuse vendor-ledger and model-gateway steps). Scenario: one turn runs through the model gateway (recordVendorSpend per call) and then executeTurn finalizes (recordTurnSpend); assert ledger input_tokens equals the session total once. Expected today: FAILS (doubled). Also record the decision: the owner derives dollars from the session, the gateway stops writing the ledger. Acceptance: scenario exists, fails for the doubled count, cucumber-js lists it; no production code in this ticket.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Double count CONFIRMED and fixed in PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/535. Scenario features/cost_call_records.feature failed before the fix (ledger input 2000 vs 1000 for one gateway call) and passes after. Decision: finalize (session-derived) is the only ledger writer; gateway only logs usage_observed. Container owner now uses defaultVendorPriceBook. Mutation check (second writer re-added) fails both scenarios. Interrupted-call estimates are no longer in the ledger (T4/T5).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged as PR 535 (T1). Verified LIVE on development 2026-10-13. A computer-owner turn wrote 2 model-call cost records into the session (0.0001858 USD, price book openai@2026-10-13+pi-ai-1.0.2, per-turn index item owner_kind computer). A Lambda turn wrote 1 record (0.000092 USD, owner_kind lambda). The ledger row matches the session records, the earlier computer-owner double count is gone, and the owner role policy for the cost partition is deployed.

right_now_summary: The double-counting bug is fixed, merged, and verified in development.
